# FSTail Solutions
> FSTail Solutions is a technology development studio from Santa Fe, Argentina, building online product catalogs and stores for entrepreneurs, websites, maintenance and custom software.

## About
FSTail Solutions builds modern web platforms, landing pages, full websites and ongoing maintenance. Clean code, precise design, measurable results. Founded in Santa Fe, Argentina. Team: Nahuel Pierini (Full Stack) and Anaclara Ferrando (Backend).

## Main pages
- [Home](https://alqmst99.github.io/profesional-plan/): Services overview, projects and contact CTA
- [About](https://alqmst99.github.io/profesional-plan/pages/about.html): Team and company story
- [Services](https://alqmst99.github.io/profesional-plan/pages/service.html): Online catalogs and stores for entrepreneurs, landing pages, full websites and maintenance
- [Projects](https://alqmst99.github.io/profesional-plan/pages/projects.html): Portfolio of client work
- [Contact](https://alqmst99.github.io/profesional-plan/pages/contact.html): Start a project
- [Blog](https://blog-fst-ecru.vercel.app/): Technical articles on performance, CSS, SEO and more

## Services
- Online product catalogs and stores for entrepreneurs: category filters, products managed from JSON, cart and WhatsApp order handoff. Card payment gateways are scoped separately. Starting prices and active promotions are shown on the Services page.
- [Pet shop catalog demo](https://alqmst99.github.io/Pet_Shop/pages/catalogo.html): example of product catalog, filters, cart and WhatsApp order flow
- Landing Page plans (Basic / Standard / Professional)
- Website Maintenance (monthly plans)
- Full Website development
- Custom software, backend systems and automation
